problem.title: Find the Depth of Every Node
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree, determine the depth of every node, where the depth of a node is the number of edges from the root.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
problem.output: • Print the depth of every node.
